==Enshrined deities==
It enshrines {{ill|Nigihayahi|fr|Nigihayahi|ja|ニギハヤヒ|simple|Nigihayahi|zh|饒速日命|qid=Q10949054|lt=Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto}} and Hirokuni Oshitate Kanahi-no-Mikoto ({{ill|Emperor Ankan|ar|الإمبراطور أنكان|arz|الامبراطور انكان|azb|آنکان (ایمپیراتور)|cs|Ankan|de|Ankan|es|Ankan Tennō|fa|امپراتور آنکان|fi|Ankan|fr|Ankan|hu|Ankan japán császár|id|Kaisar Ankan|it|Ankan|ja|安閑天皇|ka|ანკანი|ko|안칸 천황|mr|अंकन|nl|Ankan|pl|Ankan|pt|Ankan|ru|Император Анкан|sh|Car Ankan|simple|Emperor Ankan|sl|Cesar Ankan|sv|Ankan (kejsare)|th|จักรพรรดิอังกัง|tl|Emperador Ankan|tr|Ankan (imparator)|uk|Імператор Анкан|uz|Imperator Ankan|vi|Thiên hoàng An Nhàn|yo|Emperor Ankan|zh|安闲天皇|zh_min_nan|Ankan Thian-hông|zh_yue|安閑天皇|qid=Q241765}}).
This area belonged to the lineage of the {{ill|Mononobe clan|de|Mononobe (Klan)|es|Clan Mononobe|fa|خاندان مونونوبه|fr|Clan Mononobe|id|Klan Mononobe|it|Clan Mononobe|ja|物部氏|ko|모노노베씨|nl|Mononobe-clan|pt|Clã Mononobe|ru|Мононобэ (род)|sh|Mononobe|uk|Рід Мононобе|vi|Gia tộc Mononobe|zh|物部氏|zh_classical|物部氏|qid=Q1755836}}, and in ''{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|de|Shinsen Shōjiroku|fr|Shinsen shōjiroku|ja|新撰姓氏録|ko|신찬성씨록|ru|Синсэн сёдзироку|zh|新撰姓氏錄|qid=Q1045362}}'' the “Takaya no Muraji” are recorded as descendants of Ikotone no Ōmuraji, 10th-generation descendant of Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto. Thus Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto was enshrined as ancestral deity. Hirokuni Oshitate Kanahi-no-Mikoto was enshrined later.

==History==
